fusions.name: Startled Dart
fusions.desc: Flings a dart that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Hind-Leg Drop
fusions.desc: Bolts up to 8 tiles to the target and drops on it for a blow that deals 14 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bolt Hole
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 9 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 25% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Always Already Gone
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
